[P1] Luis Fonsi

[P2] 8 (Luis Fonsi album)
8 is the eighth studio album of Puerto Rican artist Luis Fonsi . He collaborated with Juan Luis Guerra in the song `` Llegaste Tú '' , a song Fonsi dedicated to his daughter Mikaela . The album was released on May 19 , 2014 .

[P3] Luis Fonsi discography
Puerto Rican singer Luis Fonsi has released seven studio albums , two compilation albums , twenty-six singles and two DVDs .

[P4] Remixes (Luis Fonsi album)

[P5] Aquí Estoy Yo

It was released as the second single from Fonsi 's album on December 1 , 2008 and became his sixth number-one single on the Billboard Hot Latin Tracks chart , the second number-song for David Bisbal on the same chart , and the first for Aleks Syntek and Noel Schajris ( as a solo performer ) .
PASSAGES>>>
